title: Principal Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
Questrade Financial Group (QFG), through its companies - Questrade, Inc., Questrade Wealth Management Inc., Community Trust Company, ThinkInsure, Zolo, and Flexiti, provides securities and foreign currency investment, professionally managed investment portfolios, mortgages, insurance, real estate services, financial services and more. Questrade uses cutting-edge technologies to develop innovative products that give customers better, more affordable ways to take control of their money.

We are everything a traditional financial institution is not. At QFG, you will be constantly moving forward, bringing the future of fintech into existence. You will be a part of a collaborative team that cares deeply about our mission and each other. Your team members will help you conquer challenges, push boundaries and discover what you are truly capable of.

This is a place where you can explore, discover and learn with continuous growth. As a diverse and inclusive place to work, with a hybrid working environment you can unleash your creativity and curiosity with no limits. If you share the same sense of infinite possibility, come shape your future at QFG.

What’s in it for you as an employee of QFG?

  • Health & wellbeing resources and programs
  • Paid vacation, personal, and sick days for work-life balance
  • Competitive compensation and benefits packages
  • Work-life balance
  • Career growth and development opportunities
  • Opportunities to contribute to community causes
  • Work with diverse team members in an inclusive and collaborative environment

We’re looking for our next Principal Cloud Platform Engineer. Could It Be You?

As a Principal Cloud Platform Engineer at our company, you will be at the forefront of developing and advancing our core cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and tooling essential for the Questrade Cloud Platform. This role is pivotal in delivering self-service capabilities to our engineering teams, enabling the seamless onboarding and operational efficiency of cloud-native applications. Your responsibilities include leading the implementation of critical infrastructure components such as Google Kubernetes Engine, Istio Service Mesh, container provisioning engines, and managing configuration and secrets alongside Terraform modules for robust infrastructure provisioning.

In this strategic position, you will work closely with project and architecture teams, applying your deep expertise to influence the design and execution of our cloud infrastructure. Your leadership will be crucial in shaping the organization's cloud roadmap, aligning infrastructure development with both present and future business needs. Furthermore, you will guide and mentor your team in the delivery of mission-critical cloud platform components and services, thereby supporting the broader enterprise objectives.

This role is a unique opportunity to drive cloud infrastructure innovation within our company, playing a key role in enabling us to meet the evolving demands of our business landscape. As a Principal Cloud Platform Engineer, your contributions will be vital in maintaining our commitment to excellence and our competitive edge in the marketplace.

In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Visionary Technical Direction: Lead the charge in setting "Production Quality" benchmarks, pioneering sophisticated cloud infrastructure with a focus on Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and rigorous automation practices to uphold a culture of technical excellence.
  • Infrastructure Design Leadership: Take charge of cloud infrastructure planning and execution, performing comprehensive architecture evaluations. Address essential elements such as system availability, performance, security, and cost efficiency, with an eye on current needs and future scalability.
  • Innovation and Process Enhancement: Spearhead initiatives to streamline and enhance processes, leveraging opportunities to advance automation and refine DevOps methodologies.
  • Technical Strategy and Insight: Offer critical insights during strategic planning sessions, influencing the technical trajectory and advocating for continuous improvement. Ensure that technical plans are in perfect alignment with the organization’s strategic ambitions.
  • Development of Superior Tooling: Lead the creation and ongoing improvement of self-service tools for cloud infrastructure and Cloud Native Application CI/CD Pipelines, providing developers with powerful, modern solutions.
  • Expert Mentorship and Guidance: Emerge as a guiding light for the team, sharing expertise, and providing coaching on design patterns, technical best practices, and emerging technologies.
  • Architectural and System Insights: Dominate technical discussions with your thought leadership, offering deep insights into system design, problem-solving, and optimization for cloud-native applications.
  • Leadership in Strategic Team Initiatives: Propel team efforts forward, focusing on architectural and procedural enhancements, thereby steering the team’s strategic direction.
  • Resource and Cost Management Innovation: Implement forward-thinking strategies to maximize cost efficiency and resource optimization, ensuring smart utilization of assets and technologies.
  • Elevation of Documentation Practices: Advocate for superior documentation practices, ensuring detailed recording of architectural decisions, design frameworks, and technical standards. Promote active knowledge exchange through impactful presentations and in-depth workshops.
  • Championing Engineering Standards: Inspire engineering teams to achieve and maintain high standards in the creation, testing, and deployment of robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant cloud-native applications.
  • Direction of Strategic Initiatives: Navigate high-stakes projects with strategic acumen, making pivotal decisions on project paths, allocation of resources, and adherence to timelines, guaranteeing the successful realization of strategic objectives.

So are YOU our next Principal Cloud Platform Engineer ? You are if you…

  • Solid understanding of cloud computing fundamentals, covering public, private, and hybrid models, and a strategic approach to applying cloud technologies.
  • Proven experience in DevOps methodologies, emphasizing continuous integration, continuous delivery, and automated testing to improve the software development lifecycle.
  • Skill in strategic planning with the ability to marry technical initiatives with overarching business goals, ensuring technological efforts bolster business achievements.
  • Expertise in crafting high availability and disaster recovery plans, aimed at bolstering system reliability and application resilience.
  • Strong background in cloud security practices, including the creation of IAM roles & policies, security groups, and management of encryption keys for comprehensive security.
  • Significant experience in designing and maintaining solutions on major public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), with a dedication to architectural best practices.
  • Proficiency in container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, with an emphasis on Kubernetes orchestration, preferably Google Kubernetes Engine.
  • Deep understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools, focusing on improving and streamlining development and deployment processes.
  • Competence in programming with languages like Python, Golang, or Bash, adhering to high standards of code quality and maintainability.
  • Extensive experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools, including Terraform, CloudFormation, or Cloud Deployment Manager, to manage infrastructure efficiently and effectively.
  • Experience or strong familiarity with Linux operating system administration, including an in-depth understanding of Linux internals such as signals, scheduling, and filesystems.
  • Robust knowledge of TCP/IP networking principles, applicable to both cloud-based and on-premises environments, including DNS, network architecture, routing, and an understanding of L3/L7 protocols.
  • Demonstrated ability in designing and implementing solutions in a microservices architecture, with a focus on creating resilient, scalable software systems.
  • Practical experience in agile development settings, utilizing methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban to enhance team productivity and project delivery.

Sounds like you? Click below to apply!

At Questrade Financial Group of Companies, with multiple office locations around the world, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and accessible work environment. This is an environment where individuals are treated with dignity and respect. Here, the unique skills and experience you bring will be valued. You will be supported and motivated, so that you can harness your unlimited potential. Our team reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and operate in. Having a collaborative and diverse team helps us push boundaries to bring the future of fintech into existence—not only for the benefit of our customers, but for those who build their career with us.

Candidates selected for an interview will be contacted directly. If you require accommodation during the recruitment/selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno | RH Tech
description:
Job description

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

A área de RH Tech é composta por três frentes, uma delas focada em automação/RPA, com o objetivo de otimizar processos em diversas áreas da companhia, como financeiro, SAC, RH, entre outras. Através da automação de tarefas repetitivas e baseadas em regras, buscamos aumentar a eficiência e reduzir custos. O desenvolvedor pleno de RPA é responsável por identificar processos passíveis de automação, implementar soluções, integrar sistemas legados e garantir a escalabilidade e o desempenho das automações. Os principais desafios desse cargo incluem a análise de processos complexos, integração com sistemas antigos, tratamento de exceções, manutenção contínua das soluções e a garantia de conformidade com normas de segurança e regulamentação.


Main responsibilities

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Administrar e gerenciar robôs de automação em todos os estágios de ambiente, contribuindo com expertise técnica os desenvolvedores juniores durante a fase de desenvolvimento das automações, aplicando QA na fase de homologação e QC na passagem para produção/pós produção.
  • Desenvolver e sustentar documentações de boas práticas de desenvolvimento em Python.
  • Trabalhar com Dockerização e containers, garantindo portabilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Desenvolver novas features e sustentar o software de uma Control Room feita internamente com high-code para orquestração de automações e integração com processos de negócio.
  • Migrar automações desenvolvidas em Automation Anywhere (A360) para Python.
  • Gerir, administrar e sustentar todo o ambiente do projeto na Azure.
  • Realizar testes, monitoramento e manutenção dos robôs para garantir a eficiência e a estabilidade das automações.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com times de TI e negócio para garantir a aderência das soluções às necessidades organizacionais.

Requirements and skills

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento e suporte de soluções RPA
  • Experiência avançada em Python para Automação (Requests, bs4, pandas, pyautogui...)
  • Experiência avançada em Python para backend e integrações de api (FastAPI, Django)
  • Experiência com CI/CD e testes automatizados (Pytest, Unittest)
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e GraphQL.
  • Experiência avançada em bancos relacionais
  • Conhecimento em bancos não relacionais (mongodb)
  • Experiência em orientação a eventos e mensageria (Service Bus/RabbitMQ)
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de documentos padronizados (PDD, SDD e demais documentações funcionais e técnicas)
  • Conhecimento em cloud (Azure, GCP ou AWS)
  • Experiência técnica de monitoramento e rastreabilidade de serviços e/ou produto (DataDog)
  • Experiência avançada em administração de servidores Linux

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Conhecimento em PowerPlatform (powerapps, powerautomate, copilot studio)
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento frontend

Additional information

Nossos benefícios:

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Allya: app que oferece descontos em quase 30 mil estabelecimentos por todo Brasil, ex: farmácia, restaurante, salão, academia, etc;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Responsável por assegurar o cumprimento dos processos e atividades diárias de assistência e cuidados ao paciente com doença renal crônica em programa de diálise, o cumprimento da prescrição de diálise pela equipe de técnicos de enfermagem sob sua supervisão, visando garantir a aplicação das melhores práticas no tratamento dialítico incluindo o cumprimento às rotinas e normas técnicas, bem como a garantia da segurança do paciente;

Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho (Projetos)

Join to apply for the Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho (Projetos) role at NTS - Nova Transportadora do Sudeste

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.
Nossos Valores:

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga:
Estamos em busca de um Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho que será responsável pela gestão de saúde e segurança das obras e projetos, incluindo identificação, mensuração e proposta para mitigação dos riscos de saúde e segurança e o atendimento à legislação vigente.
Responsabilidades:
  • Identificar, analisar e mitigar os riscos ocupacionais associados às atividades das frentes de serviço, implementando medidas preventivas e corretivas para reduzir os riscos de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais.
  • Elaborar e coordenar os processos/procedimentos de segurança de obras, seguindo o direcional do programa de integração de SSMA, elaboração de planos de ação, treinamentos e gestão dos requisitos legais, objetivando o cumprimento das devidas normas.
  • Atendimento aos requisitos legais de saúde e segurança relativos às frentes de serviços da NTS pautadas nas Normas Regulamentadoras, leis municipais, estaduais e federais.
  • Realizar treinamentos e outras comunicações para funcionários NTS sobre documentos internos e outros processos relativos a saúde e segurança, com objetivo de capacitá-los e conscientizá-los sobre a importância do cuidado ativo genuíno.
  • Realizar Integração de SSMA para prestadores de serviço antes do início de suas atividades para NTS, com o objetivo de apresentar os riscos das atividades, política e norma NTS e a importância de gerenciar riscos e desenvolver comportamentos seguros.
  • Realizar Briefing de segurança para todos aqueles que nunca acessaram as instalações da NTS, conscientizando-os dos riscos existentes em cada área visitada e como proceder em emergências.
  • Contribuir ativamente na gestão do Sistema de Gestão Integrado da NTS, incentivando o processo de melhoria contínua, ajustando procedimentos para refletir a realidade de campo.
  • Atuar como suporte nos cenários de resposta à emergência nas frentes da NTS, participando dos simulados de emergência, definindo junto as áreas plano de ação eficaz para reduzir e/ou eliminar os perigos existentes nas atividades / instalações da NTS.
  • Seguir as diretrizes de gerenciamento de incidentes, de acordo com a classificações da NTS, disseminar alertas de incidentes com a força de trabalho do campo, principalmente quanto aos incidentes de alto potencial e suas tratativas.

description:
Overview

Nós somos KeminSomos visionários que veem as coisas de forma diferente e são inspirados pelo mundo que nos rodeia. Há mais de meio século que nos dedicamos a utilizar a ciência aplicada para melhorar a qualidade de vida.Somos um fabricante global de ingredientes que se esforça todos os dias para transformar de forma sustentável a qualidade de vida de 80% da população mundial com seus produtos e serviços.Por mais de meio século, a Kemin tem se dedicado a usar a ciência aplicada para enfrentar os desafios da indústria e oferecer soluções de produtos a clientes em mais de 120 países. A Kemin fornece ingredientes para alimentar uma população crescente com seu compromisso com a qualidade, segurança e eficácia de alimentos, rações e produtos relacionados à saúde para clientes em todo o mundo.Fundada em 1961, a Kemin é uma empresa privada, de propriedade e operação familiar, com mais de 2.800 funcionários globais e operações em 90 países, incluindo instalações de fabricação na Bélgica, Brasil, China, Índia, Itália, Rússia, San Marino, Cingapura, África do Sul e Estados Unidos.

O objetivo desta posição é assegurar que os processos da Kemin estejam dentro da legislação vigente, cumprindo com todas as obrigações pertinentes a Saúde, Meio Ambiente e Segurança do Trabalho. Propor alternativas de melhorias de processos relacionados as áreas de sua responsabilidade, garantindo um ambiente seguro, confiável e de acordo com a legislação.

Responsibilities

  • Acompanhar a elaboração e a execução do PPRA – Programa de Prevenção e Riscos Ambientais e do LTCAT, avaliando os dados criteriosamente a fim de propor melhorias e adaptações de acordo com o negócio.
  • Acompanhar a elaboração e administrar o PCMSO – Programa de Controle e Medicina Ocupacional.
  • Administrar e acompanhar os Laudos Técnicos e Ergonômicos.
  • Propor melhorias e adequações relacionadas a ergonomia e segurança, visando um local seguro e confortável para os colaboradores.
  • Enviar os relatórios, registros e certificados obrigatórios aos Órgãos Públicos (Ministério do Trabalho, Sindicatos etc.).
  • Garantir e cobrar a utilização dos EPIs Equipamento de Proteção Individual e EPC´s (Equipamento de Proteção Coletiva) para os colaboradores e os departamentos, controlando a entrega e utilização, visando à redução dos riscos à segurança e integridade física do trabalhador.
  • Promover inspeções nos locais de trabalho, identificando condições perigosas, tomando todas as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de riscos, bem como treinar e conscientizar os funcionários quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho.
  • Controlar e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, organizar a Brigada de Emergência, promover o treinamento de Abandono de Área, cumprindo a legislação.
  • Colaborar nos projetos de modificações prediais ou novas instalações da empresa, visando a criação de condições mais seguras no trabalho.
  • Pesquisar e analisar as causas de doenças ocupacionais e as condições ambientais em que ocorreram, tomando as providências exigidas em lei, evitando sua reincidência, bem como corrigir as condições insalubres causadoras dessas doenças.
  • Preparar programas de treinamentos técnicos sobre segurança do trabalho, incluindo programas de integração, conscientização e divulgação de normas de segurança, para o desenvolvimento de uma atitude preventiva quanto à segurança do trabalho.
  • Realizar a integração de Segurança de novos funcionários, bem como de prestadores de serviços.
  • Promover campanhas, palestras relacionadas com Saúde, Segurança e Qualidade de Vida no Trabalho e em Casa, com o objetivo de conscientizar o trabalhador.
  • Administrar, acompanhar e realizar o processo de renovação da CIPA em seus programas, estudando suas observações e proposições, visando adotar soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho.
  • Prestar apoio à SIPAT, organizando as atividades e recursos necessários.
  • Levantar e estudar os indicadores de acidentes do trabalho, doenças profissionais e do trabalho, analisando suas causas e gravidade, adotando medidas preventivas.
  • Preparar e enviar o reporte das análises de acidente.
  • Avaliar os casos de acidente do trabalho, acompanhando o acidentado para recebimento de atendimento médico adequado.
  • Atuar de acordo com as normas, leis e procedimentos internos vigentes do departamento e da empresa.

Qualifications

  • Formação Técnica em Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Desejável formação Técnica em Meio Ambiente.
  • Desejável superior completo ou cursando em Engenharia de Segurança.
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Conhecimento das legislações vigentes (NR´s e legislação trabalhista).
  • Conhecimentos em PPRA, PCMSO, LTCAT e demais documentos obrigatórios.
  • Realização de palestras e treinamentos.
  • Análises técnicas de documentos.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar no segundo turno (13h às 22h50).

About Grupo Pereira

title: Engenheiro Hidrotécnico Pleno
description:
Profissional especializado na área de engenharia hidrotécnica, que envolve o planejamento, projeto em níveis conceitual, básico e executivo, verificação, acompanhamento e gestão de obras e sistemas relacionados aos recursos hídricos, como rios, barragens de água e rejeitos, pilhas, cavas, canais, sistemas de drenagem, além de estudos de balanço hídrico, saneamento, estudos de Dam Break, sedimentológicos e mudanças climáticas. O objetivo principal desse engenheiro é garantir o uso eficiente e sustentável dos recursos hídricos, além de proteger a população e/ou empreendedores contra riscos associados à água, como inundações, secas e poluição.

ATIVIDADES-CHAVE:

  • Realizar estudos para avaliar a disponibilidade e demanda de água, desenvolver planos de manejo de bacias hidrográficas e propor estratégias para o uso sustentável dos recursos hídricos;
  • Desenvolver projetos e realizar cálculos hidráulicos e hidrológicos para construção de sistemas extravasores de barragens, canais, entre outras estruturas relacionadas à água. Isso inclui a elaboração de desenhos técnicos, especificações e estimativas de custos;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de drenagem para prevenir inundações e controlar o escoamento de água em áreas urbanas, industriais e rurais. Isso pode envolver a construção de canais, diques, reservatórios de retenção e sistemas de bombeamento;
  • Desenvolver estudos de Dam Break, balanço hídrico, sedimentológicos, drenagem superficial, manual de operação, mudanças climáticas, dentre outros relacionados à disciplina de recursos hídricos;
  • Monitorar e gerenciar o uso e a qualidade da água em rios, lagos e aquíferos. Isso pode incluir o desenvolvimento de planos de gestão de recursos hídricos, a implementação de programas de monitoramento da qualidade da água e a proposição de medidas de conservação e proteção dos ecossistemas aquáticos;
  • Realizar estudos de impacto ambiental para avaliar os efeitos de obras e projetos relacionados à água no meio ambiente e nas comunidades locais (Ex: turbidez). Esses estudos visam identificar e mitigar possíveis impactos negativos, além de promover a sustentabilidade e o equilíbrio ambiental;
  • Utilizar softwares especializados para realizar análises hidráulicas e simular o comportamento dos sistemas hídricos, permitindo a previsão de enchentes, o dimensionamento adequado de estruturas e a avaliação de cenários de gestão de recursos hídricos;
  • Trabalhar em equipe com profissionais de diferentes áreas, como geólogos, biólogos, arquitetos e urbanistas, para garantir a integração eficiente de aspectos técnicos, ambientais e sociais nos projetos hidrotécnicos.

PRINCIPAIS ENTREGÁVEIS:

  • Estudos e relatórios técnicos;
  • Projetos e desenhos técnicos;
  • Modelagem e simulação hidráulica;
  • Planos de gestão de recursos hídricos;
  • Supervisão;
  • Relatórios complexos de projetos de hidrologia e hidráulica.

REQUISITOS:

  • Graduação em Engenharia Civil, Ambiental, Sanitária, Hídrica ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos técnicos específicos em hidrologia, hidráulica, drenagem, planejamento de recursos hídricos, gestão de bacias hidrográficas, entre outros;
  • Experiência prévia na área.

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Doutorado, Mestrado ou especialização na área de atuação;
  • Experiência na mesma função em empresas do segmento (consultoria);
  • Experiência em empresas referência do segmento (consultoria);

  • Experiência em softwares de modelagem hidráulica 3D;
  • Experiência com programação;
  • Especialização em Hidrologia ou Recursos Hídricos.

description:
About Us

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more .

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day.

About the Role

We are looking for a business-minded Data Analyst to join our growing team in Brazil. You will become a fraud expert, working closely with many internal teams (Sales, Integrations, Product, Analytics, Data Science etc.), and will be responsible for creating accurate performance projections for Riskified’s merchants.

You’ll leverage your analytical skills and knowledge of our product to provide meaningful insights to our enterprise customers by conducting pilots for each merchant as part of our pre-sale and onboarding process. Occasionally, you will even interact and share analysis directly with merchants.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Simulate performance and lead pilots as part of the pre-sale and onboarding of new merchants
  • Resolve merchants’ onboarding queries on a day-to-day basis
  • Use analytical tools in a high level technical environment
  • Share deep analysis conclusions and use sophisticated technical methods to present to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Deliver analytic insights for our Sales teams
  • Master the online fraud prevention domain through hands-on analysis of live data in the Riskified platform
  • Identify, research, and offer system-wide solutions for common issues
Qualifications
  • Fluency (written and verbal) in English and Portuguese required
  • 2+ years hands-on work experience with SQL
  • 2+ hands-on work experience with R or Python (functions creation, data wrangling)
  • Strong analytical skills with complex data
  • Experienced problem solver and critical thinker
  • Great communication skills
  • Ability to work simultaneously on different tasks and lead multiple projects
  • A competitive streak and willingness to go the extra mile to win deals
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree - preferably in a highly-quantitative field (i.e. mathematics, statistics, computer science, natural sciences), economics or business administration

description:

Join to apply for the HPC Software Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
HPC is an important and technically challenging compute domain, with specialised tooling and a very high expectation of precision, efficiency and automation. This role is for a software engineer to join our HPC team to deliver an outstanding HPC experience - from bare metal to public cloud - as part of the broader Ubuntu platform. We are looking for a range of skills and experience, and will work on everything from the kernel to Debian packaging, but the heart of our effort will be Python software development for automation of key software in the HPC sphere. Our focus is on delivering a world class experience for the operation of the HPC cluster itself.
You will be part of the team that delivers charms that deploy and manage the HPC cluster and provide HPC software packages.
To succeed in this application you must be outstanding at maths and sciences, have built high quality software, have learned about open source ideally by working on it directly, and be looking for an engineering role with a company that makes mission-critical products for the global market. You should also be familiar with the open source environment, and want to build products in partnership with a community. Ideally, you should have some experience of high performance computing environments and a desire to unlock HPC for the world.
For this role you must have experience with Python. Experience in HPC environments is a strong advantage. Familiarity with HPC hardware and software is also a strong advantage - delivering great experiences with Infiniband, RDMA, CUDA, MPI, Slurm, Lustre, Singularity and related technologies will be central to this team's work. It will also be advantageous to have experience with Docker image design and operations, and public cloud image design and operations.
Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA or the Americas regions
What your day will look like

  • Write high quality, rigorously designed Python software
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Contribute to technical documentation that define best practices for authoring high quality operators
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with writing modern, maintainable Python
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest and experience with two or more of the following: Linux, Kubernetes, Public cloud, OpenStack, LXC/LXD, Python, Go, Debian packaging
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience operating HPC clusters in production
  • Experiences with Infiniband, RDMA, CUDA, MPI, Slurm, Lustre, and/or Singularity
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

O Atacadão é a única rede atacadista alimentar presente em todos os estados do Brasil, com 415 pontos de operação, sendo 379 lojas de autosserviço e 36 atacados de entrega e centros de distribuição, que juntos alcançam 95% dos 5.570 municípios do país.

Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta & biodiversidade.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include major public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. We are a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with over 1200 colleagues in 75+ countries and few office-based roles. Teams meet in person 2-4 times a year in interesting locations worldwide to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We have created a new leadership role, Channel Marketing Director , to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and a leading open source provider, we play a vital role in innovative value chains like Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, and IoT, supporting our partners technically and commercially.

Reporting to the VP of Marketing, you will lead a team of marketing managers managing partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner for open source-based products and solutions. You will be responsible for maximizing the ROI of our campaigns supporting various partner sales motions.

The partner marketing team comprises talented professionals skilled in formulating joint value propositions, running lead generation campaigns, creating impactful messages/assets, and selecting effective channels through complex supply chains. They are passionate about technology, enterprise users, and advanced partner analytics technologies.

Location: This role is home-based in the AMER region.

The role entails:

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue through key partners such as Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, and GSI.
  • Aligning with growth, field, and product marketing to deliver integrated activities.
  • Executing partner campaigns from recruitment to demand generation.
  • Engaging and elevating the partner community with exceptional content.
  • Multiplying partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Creating bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out.
  • Championing partner collaboration internally and externally.
  • Managing Marketing Development Funds (MDF) usage.
  • Driving adoption of analytics and reporting tools to improve ROI.
  • Mentoring and developing a diverse team of partner marketers.
  • Cultivating a culture of testing and optimization.

What we are looking for in you

  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud providers, and channels.
  • Leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven success in co-marketing programs in the tech space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities.
  • Ability to foster a culture of excellence, agility, and self-drive.
  • Curiosity and continuous learning habits.
  • Outstanding English communication skills, verbal and written.
  • Excellent academic results at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events.

Additional preferred experience:

  • Familiarity with specific verticals like Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive.
  • Experience leading distributed teams across time zones.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints.
  • USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget.
  • Annual compensation review and performance bonuses.
  • Recognition rewards, holiday leave, maternity/paternity leave.
  • Wellness programs and travel opportunities.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneer in open source, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We recruit globally, set high standards, and expect excellence. Most colleagues work remotely, and working here challenges you to think differently, learn new skills, and innovate.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

title: Projetista Elétrico Industrial
description:
O Projetista Elétrico Industrial será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e detalhamento de projetos elétricos voltados para instalações e sistemas industriais, garantindo a segurança, eficiência e conformidade com normas técnicas aplicáveis. Atua na elaboração de projetos de infraestrutura elétrica, painéis, automação, força e comando, colaborando diretamente com equipes de engenharia, manutenção e produção.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver projetos elétricos industriais de baixa e média tensão, incluindo instalações de força, comando e controle.
  • Elaborar diagramas elétricos (unifilares, trifilares e multifilares), layouts de instalações, listas de materiais e memoriais descritivos.
  • Projetar sistemas de distribuição elétrica em plantas industriais, incluindo painéis, subestações, motores, CLPs, sistemas de iluminação e aterramento.
  • Dimensionar cabos, disjuntores, proteções e sistemas de automação industrial.
  • Realizar especificação técnica de materiais, equipamentos e dispositivos elétricos.
  • Interpretar normas técnicas (NBR 5410, NBR 14039, NR-10, NR-12, IEC, entre outras) e garantir a aderência dos projetos.
  • Auxiliar na definição de padrões elétricos para plantas industriais e participar de auditorias técnicas.
  • Realizar visitas a campo para levantamento de dados, acompanhamento de obras e suporte à instalação.
  • Utilizar softwares de CAD elétrico (AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, SolidWorks Electrical ou equivalentes).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de automação, instrumentação e mecânica para integração de projetos multidisciplinares.

Requisitos:

Formação:

  • Curso Técnico em Eletrotécnica, Técnico em Projetos Elétricos, Tecnólogo em Engenharia Elétrica ou Superior em Engenharia Elétrica (cursando ou completo).

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Sistemas de potência e distribuição elétrica industrial.
  • Proteção elétrica e seletividade de circuitos.
  • Dimensionamento elétrico conforme normas brasileiras e internacionais.
  • Softwares de CAD para projetos elétricos industriais.
  • Conhecimento básico em automação e instrumentação é um diferencial.

Experiência:

  • Mínimo de 2 a 3 anos atuando em projetos elétricos industriais.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Atenção a detalhes e foco em qualidade técnica.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica e de propor melhorias técnicas.

Presencial em São Caetano do Sul , Disponibilidade para visitas a campo e viagens )

Segunda a sexta-feira, das 7h às 17h)

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge in Kotlin, Scala and Go programming languages;
  • Knowledge in Functional programming;

  • Knowledge in Static Analysis and Dynamic Analysis of code.

title: Senior Rotating Equipment Specialist
description:
Job Summary

This is a senior subject matter expert (SME) role to support the Maintenance Superintendent in the maintenance of all rotating equipment on the site. The candidate must be able to provide SME knowledge, experience, and leadership for this role.

Utilize their broad range of skills and experience:

  • Lead and manage routine and major services on Reciprocating gas compressors and Reciprocating Gas Engines.
  • Root Cause analysis investigations.
  • Provide SME expertise and knowledge.
  • Ensure maximum uptime and reduce business losses.
  • Execute strategies developed by the Maintenance Excellence Manager.
  • Create and implement safe, reliable, efficient plans for rotating equipment maintenance.
  • Introduce condition monitoring technologies.
  • Provide input for rotating equipment budget.
  • Coach and assess junior technicians.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee and drive implementation of the maintenance plan and performance improvements.
  • Lead all reciprocating rotating equipment maintenance, corrective maintenance, and troubleshooting.
  • Lead major overhauls and interventions on reciprocating rotating equipment.
  • Extensive experience in fault finding on reciprocating rotating equipment.
  • Extensive experience in overhauling reciprocating rotating equipment.
  • Develop reliability plans for all rotating equipment.
  • Ensure all activities undertaken by the maintenance team follow the CreDan and regulatory HSSE standards.
  • Deploy condition monitoring tools and methods to improve reliability.
  • Improve equipment reliability and availability.
  • Drive production improvement for the plant through investigation of losses and deep understanding of rotating equipment performance.
  • Deliver main equipment overhauls against agreed plan and costs.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

  • A minimum of 15 years’ experience in a senior rotating equipment maintenance position in the oil & gas industry on reciprocating rotating equipment, specifically gas engine compressor packages.
  • A minimum of 5 years leading teams in maintenance and overhauls.
  • Comprehensive troubleshooting of technical issues is a must. Subject matter expert (SME) in maintenance techniques on gas engines and gas compressors and associated equipment.
  • Proven tuning and setting up of gas engines and gas compressors.
  • Mechanical Technical Institute educated.

title: Hardware Engineer
description:
TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Hardware Engineer, you will play a critical role in the design, development, and optimization of our cutting-edge hardware components and systems. Your expertise will contribute to a new generation of devices, developing new features and products from scratch, selecting components, and layouting PCBs. Always guaranteeing the reliability, performance, standard compliance, and scalability of our IoT products, and enabling seamless monitoring and management of industrial assets.

Responsibilities

Take ownership of hardware design projects, including conceptualization, schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout.

Develop innovative and efficient hardware solutions that meet project requirements and specifications, following standards such as IEC 60079 (IECEx) and IEC 61010 (Electrical Safety).

Define and execute test plans to verify the performance, reliability, and compatibility of hardware designs.

Adapt the project and provide documentation for telecommunications standards and certifications such as FCC, IFT, CE and ANATEL.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as software engineering, firmware engineering, and product management, to ensure seamless integration and interoperability of hardware components.

Troubleshoot hardware-related issues by investigating and diagnosing problems, identifying root causes, and recommending appropriate solutions.

Document findings, test results, and hardware performance metrics in a clear and concise manner.

Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related field.

Minimum of 5 years of experience in hardware engineering and electronics.

Proficiency in schematic capture and PCB layout tools such as KiCAD and Altium Designer.

Experience utilizing laboratory equipment and tools for hardware testing, analysis and troubleshooting.

Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey complex technical information effectively.

Experience with design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA).

Familiarity with hardware design for low-power and battery-operated devices.

Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Live or have availability to move to Sao Paulo.

Bonus Points

Knowledge of programming languages, such as C/C++ or Python, for test automation and data analysis purposes.

Strong understanding of Antenna Designing.

Strong understanding of Telecommunication Technologies.

Strong understanding of AC/DC and DC/DC converters.

Experience with Hazardous Locations Certifications (ATEX and IECEx).

Experience with Telecommunication Certifications (FCC, IFT, CE)

COMPENSATION

• Competitive salary and stock options

• Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses

• 30 days of paid annual leave

• Education and courses stipend

• Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years

• Day off during the week of your birthday

• R$200 a month for remote work allowance

• Mental health support: we cover 40% of the cost of your therapy

• Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation

• Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.

• Up to R$5.000 bonus for referring new Blue Caps

Sobre a área:

A posição tem como objetivo atuar como referência técnica em soluções de mensageria baseadas em RabbitMQ , garantindo a alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e observabilidade dos clusters utilizados em ambientes críticos. Será responsável pelo desenho, implementação, manutenção e melhoria contínua da plataforma de mensageria do grupo, promovendo boas práticas de arquitetura, automação e segurança.

No seu dia a dia:

  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica atualizada, playbooks e manuais operacionais.

Esperamos de você:

  • Formação completa
  • Sólido conhecimento de RabbitMQ: funcionamento interno, tuning, políticas de mirror/queue, quorum queues, federation, shovel.
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código (IaC) e automação de ambientes.
  • Conhecimento em Linux (administração e troubleshooting).
  • Vivência em ambientes com alta disponibilidade, performance crítica e observabilidade madura.
  • Familiaridade com protocolo AMQP, mensageria assíncrona, conceitos de backpressure, ack/nack, redelivery, etc.

  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido no escritório na Faria Lima em São Paulo ou em Botafogo no Rio de Janeiro.

  • Desconto em Farmácia;
  • Programa de Nutrição;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida – empresa Cidadã.

O BTG Pactual respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade.

Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

As a Manufacturing Engineer at Tractian, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the highest quality standards for our hardware products and solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including design, manufacturing, and quality assurance, to ensure that our products meet rigorous quality requirements and exceed customer expectations. Additionally, you will be responsible for identifying and collaborating with suppliers who share our commitment to excellence, further enhancing our supply chain efficiency and ensuring the consistent quality of our NPIs.   • Participate in the NPI of new sensors and technologies.
  • Work closely with the production team to support process validation and ensure consistency in manufacturing processes.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Experience with Engineering Projects and Manufacturing Techniques.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles, materials, and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience with inspection techniques, metrology, GD&T, and non-destructive testing methods.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to lead root cause analysis investigations.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Injection molding, CNC machining, and other manufacturing processes.

Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

Função/Descrição do Trabalho:

O Enfermeiro Pleno atuará na ConvaCare Medical Care, uma clínica especializada no atendimento a pacientes com feridas, estomias e incontinência. A vaga corresponde a 44 horas semanais, com horários escalonados e sem posto de trabalho fixo, com atendimentos tanto domiciliares quanto em instituições de saúde.

Responsabilidades Chave:

Assistência ao Paciente:

  • Realizar consultas de enfermagem, incluindo a avaliação e atendimento a pacientes com feridas, estomias e incontinência.
  • Prescrever ações de enfermagem, prestar assistência direta a pacientes com complicações e realizar procedimentos de maior complexidade, sempre acionando a equipe médica quando necessário.
  • Registrar cuidados e procedimentos prestados no prontuário eletrônico da Clínica ConvaCare.
  • Demarcar o local onde será implantado o futuro estoma, conforme solicitação da operadora de saúde e/ou da Clínica ConvaCare.
  • Realizar visitas domiciliares conforme solicitação, avaliando as condições do estoma e do paciente, prescrevendo os cuidados necessários e orientando sobre a manutenção do estoma e do equipamento.

Educação e Autocuidado:

  • Orientar os pacientes e seus cuidadores sobre os cuidados com o estoma, lesões de pele e aspectos relacionados à higiene, alimentação, sono e outros fatores que influenciam a cicatrização e a qualidade de vida.
  • Estimular e/ou auxiliar o retorno dos pacientes à participação social.
  • Planejar e executar visitas domiciliares para acompanhar a evolução do quadro do paciente e ajustar as orientações de autocuidado conforme necessário.

Acompanhamento e Monitoramento:

  • Avaliar de forma contínua as atividades assistenciais prestadas, ajustando os cuidados conforme a evolução do paciente.
  • Prescrever coberturas e equipamentos conforme os critérios estabelecidos em protocolo.
  • Solicitar e monitorar a busca ativa dos pacientes faltosos ou com risco de abandono do tratamento.

Coordenação de Equipe:

  • Coordenar as ações de enfermagem, orientando a equipe durante a execução dos procedimentos necessários.
  • Encaminhar o paciente para a equipe multidisciplinar, quando necessário, para garantir o acompanhamento integral.

Limitações e Protocolos:

  • Não prescrever ou aplicar produtos que não estejam previstos no protocolo da clínica.

Habilidades Chave:

  • Experiência comprovada no atendimento ao paciente com feridas, estomias e incontinência.
  • Conhecimento em informática, especialmente pacote Office, para registros e comunicação interna.
  • Dinamismo, proatividade e excelente capacidade de trabalho em equipe.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Enfermagem.
  • Pós-graduação em Estomaterapia (desejável).
  • Experiência prévia em atendimento de pacientes com estomias, feridas e incontinência.
  • Habilidade para orientação e acompanhamento de pacientes e familiares.

Condições de Trabalho:

  • Vaga de 44 horas semanais com escalas variáveis.
  • Atendimentos domiciliares e em clínica Convacare.
  • Preferencialmente com Inglês e/ou Espanhol

Nosso objetivo é que dentro dos próximos 10 anos, possamos gerar mudanças positivas na saúde de 2.5 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We have created a new leadership role, Channel Marketing Director, to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we play a unique role in a variety of innovative value chains (Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, IoT) supporting our partners both technically and commercially.
Reporting to the VP of Marketing you will lead a team of marketing managers running partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open source based products and solutions. In this role you will ultimately be responsible for maximising the overall ROI of our campaigns supporting our partners motions whether sell-to, sell-through or sell-with.
The partner marketing team is formed of multi-talented marketing professionals, as comfortable formulating joint value propositions as they are about running lead generation campaigns. They have an eye for creating remarkable messages/assets and a hand in the selection of the most effective channels through a complex supply chain. They are passionate about technology, the users of enterprise technology, and are early adopters of advanced partner analytics technologies.
Location: This role is home based in the AMER region.
The role entails

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue outcomes through key partners – Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, GSIs, etc.
  • Aligning with growth, field and product marketing to deliver activities integrated with Canonical's campaigns.
  • Owning the execution of partner campaigns across the funnel from recruitment to demand generation programs.
  • Engaging and elevating the partner community through exceptional content in partnership with the communication, product and alliances teams.
  • Multiplying our partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Crafting bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out in the marketplace.

  • Managing the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF) whether we receive it or distribute it.

  • Mentoring and developing a diverse team of partner marketers covering our whole spectrum of partners.
  • Cultivating a culture of continuous testing and optimization.
What we are looking for in you
  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channels is essential for this role.
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful co-marketing programs in the technology space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities and touchpoints.
  • Ability to create a culture of excellence, agility and self-drive in your team.
  • Curiosity with a habit of continuous learning.
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional academic results both at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we are looking for in you
  • Familiarity with a particular vertical (e.g. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive).

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. title: Brazil Business Unit Leader
description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. We are actively looking for our Brazil Business Unit Leader. This leader will guide the strategic growth of the established Brazil offices in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro by leading efforts to identify, capture and complete projects in the ports, marine terminal, coastal, water resources/stormwater, transportation, energy, environmental, national, state, local, and urban development markets.

The best candidate for this role will lead the team to:

  • Achieve Moffatt & Nichol and client objectives; enhance client and employee satisfaction through effective business unit operations; ensure staff management and development.
  • Deploy and manage project resources, including subconsultants and vendors.
  • Provide oversight of project phases (planning, set-up, execution, and closure) while in conformance with M&N business and client contract requirements.
  • Coordinate with the various M&N practices and Region Operations Manager to identify additional markets and potential office locations within Brazil.
  • Develop staffing strategy, staffing levels, and organizational structure.
  • Manage and maintain resources within the offices, and work to continue to attract top talent in the industry for growth and to maintain client service.

About Moffatt & Nichol:

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading U.S.-based global infrastructure advisor specializing in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines, harbours, and rivers. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 in Marine and Port Facilities and among the Top 50 Designers in International Markets.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, and the Pacific Rim. The firm provides clients worldwide with customized service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practice areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties and responsibilities:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Lead the Business Unit to achieve Key Performance Indicators:
    • Identify, evaluate, and pursue approved business and market opportunities.
    • Develop and direct execution of strategy for office growth and staff resource expansion.
    • Develop an Annual Operating Plan and Budget for the Brazil Business Unit, and manage the Business Unit to achieve planned results.
    • Establish and manage a project portfolio and coordinate with other Business Unit Leaders (BULs) to facilitate work share and mutual achievement of financial results.
    • Assist in promoting company-wide services across Brazil and related markets.
    • Work with Project Managers (PMs) and key staff in the preparation of comprehensive scopes of services with associated consulting fees; negotiate scope/fees with public and private sector clients.
    • Advise M&N on local business climate and trends, opportunities, changes in local A-E consulting practices (laws, rules, regulations, licensing, taxes), politics, and other issues pertinent to business operations.
    • Ensure M&N policies, procedures, and any applicable legislation and regulations are communicated, understood, and implemented within the Business Unit.
    • Ensure Business Unit compliance to Moffatt & Nichol Quality Management Initiatives.
    • Provide a safe and secure work environment by effectively managing the facility.
    • Negotiate and execute corporate documents and other binding instruments.
    • Identify obstacles to success and participate in improvement initiatives.
    • Identify project pursuits and develop capture plans leading to successful project wins.
  • Lead and ensure all projects and project managers meet Key Performance Indicators:
    • Review and approve project approach, plan, schedule, and budget with PMs.
    • Conduct client debriefs at designated project milestones; resolve elevated client concerns or demands not addressed by the PM.
    • Mentor, guide, advise, and ensure PMs accountability for project performance and deliverables, assist with assignment requests and approve project team assignments.
    • Participate in significant Project Reviews, review Project Progress Reports, and direct appropriate changes.
    • Ensure that Quality Control is implemented and managed in accordance with contracts and Project Plans.
    • Approve Subcontracting Plans and verify that candidate subconsultants will likely result in achievement of subcontracting goals.
    • Approve selection of subconsultants.
    • Coordinate with Business Development staff and other M&N groups to manage client relationships and satisfaction.
    • Ensure that pursuit opportunities align with objectives of the firm, approve pursuit and proposal budgets, and Proposal Number Requests within the Moffatt & Nichol’s pursuit management system.
  • Lead, develop, and oversee staff, including hiring, performance management, and succession planning:
    • Effectively lead and motivate Business Unit employees for a positive impact on retention, and an engaged, motivated, and sustainable workforce.
    • Ensure that succession plans are established and implemented as required for transfer of industry relationships and technical skillsets.
    • Identify staffing and hiring needs for the Business Unit; organize hiring teams, confirm/approve hiring decisions.
    • Conduct staff performance reviews and provide annual merit and bonus recommendations.
    • Initiate and approve off-cycle merit and bonus recommendations as needed.
    • Lead staff performance management and performance improvement for the Business Unit; approve and implement termination decisions.
    • Maintain a working environment in the Brazil offices that not only fosters productivity, but that enables staff growth, development and leadership opportunities.

Other duties:

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in an engineering or related civil/environmental infrastructure field; required.
  • 20+ years’ experience in the consultancy addressing planning engineering design, infrastructure development, project management, client service, and business development; required.
  • National engineering registration in Brazil or ability to receive thru reciprocity within 6 months; required.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience overseeing projects, staff, and client relationships; required.
  • A solid reputation with private sector clients as well as local and state government agencies, and a knowledge of coastal, water resources/stormwater, ports, marine terminal, transportation, energy, environmental, governmental or urban development markets throughout Brazil; required.
  • Proven success directing design and construction of a wide range of infrastructure projects; required.
  • Proven success in leading people and managing resources.
  • In depth understanding of Brazil’s infrastructure and resiliency market as it relates to Moffatt & Nichol’s three Practice Areas: Water, Ports, and Transportation.
  • Established Brazilian client relationships and knowledge of national, state and local government agencies.
  • Knowledge of the permitting and concession processes Moffatt & Nichol’s that apply to infrastructure projects within Brazil.
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171.

Working conditions:

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

Moffatt & Nichol’s EEO Statement:

As a global business, Moffatt & Nichol relies on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goal of Creative People, Practical Solutions serving our client needs, and ensures nondiscrimination in all activities. We draw from the world’s best and brightest, regardless of geographic, cultural, or institutional background. This approach enables us to better understand and serve our clients, foster innovation, and create a rich, collaborative work environment. Moffatt & Nichol is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity / Federal Contractor desiring priority referrals of all protected veterans for job openings.

If you need more information or require special assistance for persons with disabilities or limited English proficiency, please contact Human Resources at (562) 590-6500 or TTY/TDD users please call 711.

Atuar como agente principal de mobilização territorial e representação institucional do projeto Territórios em Foco , garantindo a presença qualificada do CIEDS e da Motiva nos territórios. Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Representar o projeto Territórios em Foco no território designado, apresentando seus objetivos, benefícios e vínculo com a Motiva/Grupo CCR.

  • Facilitar o fluxo de informações entre comunidade, Motiva e CIEDS, mantendo registros atualizados e repassando percepções relevantes.
  • Relatar desafios e identificar oportunidades de fortalecimento institucional nos territórios.
  • Atuar com ética, responsabilidade institucional e respeito às diretrizes do projeto e à diversidade local.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior: completo, preferencialmente nos cursos de Ciências Sociais, Psicologia, Serviço Social, Pedagogia ou áreas correlatas ao campo social e comunitário.
  • Tempo de vivência: de 1 a 2 anos em projetos sociais, comunitários ou de desenvolvimento local.

Diferenciais:

  • Compreensão do papel da unidade de negócio da CCR no território, incluindo impactos sociais e ambientais.
  • Experiência anterior com projetos de mobilização social e comunitária.

Obrigatório residir no local de atuação. As vagas são destinadas aos seguintes estados:

  • Rio de Janeiro
  • São Paulo
  • Rio Grande do Sul
  • Paraná

title: Cloud Architect
description:
The Cloud Solutions Architect is responsible for the design, implementation and advanced technical support of Private and Public Cloud environments. The incumbent will collaborate closely with our external partners, as well as internal Infrastructure, Applications, Security and Network teams to establish a scalable and dynamic Hybrid Cloud landscape focused on the agile delivery of Business solutions. This role will be responsible for integrating both On-Prem and Cloud-native solutions and services, as well as providing support for Cloud migration, operations and maintenance for IaaS, PaaS, SaaS workloads.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop, document and maintain Cloud Strategy and Governance process
  • Develop, document and maintain Cloud Standards and Policies
  • Lead contract efforts with Managed Service Providers and support providers
  • Drive the development of effective Cloud solutions that meet organizational and business requirements
  • Create detailed Cloud infrastructure and applications technical designs, ensuring alignment to the IT Solutions Architecture, IT Roadmap and applicable Standards
  • Effectively execute proof of concept exercises and drive solutioning efforts
  • Provide Cloud cost management/optimization, consumption and quota management and capacity forecasting and tracking services
  • Provide Project Management services
  • Review, configure, and provide advanced technical support for existing Cloud workloads
  • Work with Vendors and Service Delivery across Private and Public Cloud environments supporting On-Prem as well as IaaS, PaaS and SaaS workloads
  • Manage subscriptions, create and manage policies for compliance
  • Implement platform protection, including network security, host security, container security and resource management security
  • Work with Application Stakeholders and Security team to perform Security management, including security operations, security policies and security alerts
  • Work with Application and Development teams to ensure DevOps Security objectives are met
  • Work with the Security team to ensure data and applications are secured, including configuring encryption, SSL/TLS certs, permissions to secrets, certificates and key rotation
  • Implement and manage Identities and Access using AD, Entra ID, B2C, and Single Sign-on functions
  • Optimize the use of Storage Accounts, Databases, Templating, Encryption and Upgrades
  • Coordinate and perform maintenance activities including Vulnerability Management and Patching
  • Optimize Data Replication services ensuring Business expectations for Data Protection and Availability SLAs are met
  • Coordinate Business Impact Analysis, Develop and Perform Business Continuity planning and exercises
  • Develop and Report key Service Levels for Cloud and Business services tracking availability, performance and security metrics
  • Implement and manage network deployment tasks such as setting NSGs, virtual networks, Firewalls, Load Balancers, VPNs and Netbond
  • Continually seek new automation and provisioning technologies and the use of services to achieve higher levels of optimization and consistency
